commands.args: {kind: arrow|line|rectangle|ellipse|pen|highlighter|redact|text|number, points: [{x,y}…] in original pixels (2, or 2..16384 for pen and highlighter), colour: [r,g,b,a], width: 0.5..512 original pixels, text?: string (text), size?: 8..1024 original pixels (text, number), number?: 1..9999 (number)}
commands.description: Deprecated alias of screenshot.execute edit.annotate: Add an annotation; answers its id

commands.description: Press and release one key with modifiers, one pass each

args.viewport: optional owned window name (for example macro-editor or compose-2), honoured by every drive command; omitted for the app window

args.viewport: optional owned window name (for example macro-editor or compose-2), honoured by every drive command; omitted for the app window
